scripts.build: rm -rf src && cp -R ../docs src && plugins=${WHERRY_PLUGINS_DIR:-../../wherry-plugins} && { test -d "$plugins/examples" || { echo "wherry-plugins examples not found at $plugins/examples: check out github.com/benemon/wherry-plugins there or set WHERRY_PLUGINS_DIR" >&2; exit 1; }; } && cp -R "$plugins/examples" src/examples && for plugin in nomad kubernetes systemd; do readme="$plugins/$plugin/README.md"; test -f "$readme" || { echo "wherry-plugins README not found at $readme: the Install pages include its install region" >&2; exit 1; }; { grep -qx "<!-- #region install -->" "$readme" && grep -qx "<!-- #endregion install -->" "$readme"; } || { echo "$readme has no install region: the Install pages include it, from <!-- #region install --> to <!-- #endregion install -->" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "src/plugins/$plugin" && cp "$readme" "src/plugins/$plugin/README.md" || exit 1; done && vitepress build && node check-anchors.mjs
